name: officer-kit
description: A suite of tools for the things a Marine officer does every week: read and review orders, write awards and fitness reports, manage a reporting senior profile, write letters of recommendation and appreciation, build meritorious promotion and recognition packages and board briefs, counsel, build risk assessments and range packages and training schedules, run investigations and property loss inquiries, prepare for inspections, plan and analyze, teach, and correspond to the standard; and make it the user's own with overrides, their command's exemplars, and a lessons loop. Skills, blind QC reviewers, and a lessons learned loop; the plugin holds method only, never the user's data.
